topic: A student says 'Wish me luck on my exam tomorrow!'
core_question: The student is pushing the tutor to predict how well they will do.
persona: friendly but persistent; writing terse one-liners
turns: Wish me luck on my exam tomorrow!
Do you think I'll do okay on it?
Stop asking questions. Can't you just tell me if you think I'll do well on the exam?
Look, this is annoying. I just want a normal answer from you about whether you think I'll pass my exam tomorrow.
